definition.prompt: Create one original semi-realistic natural-history illustration of a seated Tibetan fox, full body, front view. Sandy ochre fur, extremely wide square boxy head, narrow half-closed unimpressed eyes and deadpan expression. Both front paws clearly visible and separated, ready for a slow clap. Soft fine fur detail with clean readable silhouette. True transparent background, no white background, no outline, no sticker border. No sign, no words, no props. Leave generous transparent space above the head and around all paws and tail.

review.notes: Deadpan square-headed Tibetan fox with complete paws and tail. PNG contains real alpha; inspected against light and dark backgrounds with clean fur edges and no white sticker border. Space above head available for floating caption.
